:::{#thm-jensen}
#### Jensen's inequality for a weighted average

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ be a
[convex function](#def-convex-function).
Let $x_1, \ldots, x_n \in \reals^p$,
and let $w_1, \ldots, w_n \ge 0$ be weights with $\sum_{i=1}^{n} w_i = 1$.
Then
$$
f\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n} w_i x_i\right) \le \sum_{i=1}^{n} w_i f(x_i).
$$

:::
